name: Hotel Sacher Salzburg
positioning: Family-owned historic hotel on the Salzach River by Salzburg's Old Town, home of the Original Sacher-Torte
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base by Salzburg's Old Town
Guests interested in Austrian tradition, from the Sacher-Torte to classic interiors

facts.text: The hotel sits directly on the banks of the Salzach River, right by Salzburg's historic Old Town.
Dining includes the modern Restaurant Sacher Grill, the traditional gourmet restaurant Zirbelzimmer and Cafe Sacher Salzburg.
The Original Sacher-Torte is served at the hotel.
Zirbelzimmer has dark wood and hunting memorabilia, and its menu is meat-heavy, with dishes such as ox fillet and beef consomme.
The Sacher Bar serves aperitifs and selected drinks, including after dinner.
The interiors focus on oil paintings, Austrian antiques and Oriental rugs.
Event spaces include the light-filled Winter Garden.
The Sacher Health Club has a modern fitness area, massages and a steam bath.
The concierge team is available around the clock.
The hotel is at Schwarzstrasse 5-7; bus lines 1, 3, 5 and 6 stop at nearby Makartplatz.

highlights.text: Rooms and suites were designed by co-owner Alexandra Winkler with French designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
A Lanz Trachten atelier craftsmanship experience is reserved for Sacher guests.
The hotel opened in 1866 as the Osterreichischer Hof and was renamed Hotel Sacher Salzburg in 2000.
Many rooms and suites have views of the Salzach River, the UNESCO-listed Old Town or Hohensalzburg Fortress.
A glass-roofed lobby is the hotel's centerpiece.

considerations.text: The wellness offer is the Sacher Health Club, with a fitness area, massages and a steam bath, open to hotel guests on request.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the traditional, formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
